name: delegator
description: Every subagent Claude starts waits for your approval: approve, refuse, approve all for the turn, change its model (suggested by the task's complexity) or add a note to its task. Then a pane shows each running agent as a pixel character with its context battery, tokens, estimated cost, time and the steps it reports, plus the agents done and a plan's progress above the prompt, the same in the terminal and the desktop app.

approveAgents.title: Approve subagents before launch
approveAgents.description: Hold every subagent Claude starts until you approve it. Off, agents launch without asking. /delegator on or off flips it too.

suggestModels.title: Suggest a model by task complexity
suggestModels.description: When Claude names no model for an agent, launch it on the one its task suggests: Haiku for lookups, Sonnet for building, Opus for design and analysis. Off, it runs on the agent's own default.

animateCharacters.title: Animate the characters
animateCharacters.description: Move each running agent's character in the Delegator pane, two frames, while it runs. Off, the characters stand still.

askForSteps.title: Ask agents to report their steps
askForSteps.description: Add one line to each agent's task asking it to report its plan and each step through the delegator's step tool, which the pane shows. Off, nothing is added.
